correctness.rationale: For the specifically labeled four-neighborly 13-vertex triangulation K=(S3×S3)^a_13, the published 208 six-simplex facets independently reconstruct f=(13,78,286,715,1014,728,208). Every four-set is a tetrahedron, so no nonzero 3-cycle is supported on fewer than five vertices. Exact independent mod-2 boundary elimination finds rank(∂3)=220, rank(∂4)=493 and dim H3=715−220−493=2. There are C(13,5)−1014=273 missing 5-sets, all carry tetrahedron-boundary 3-cycles, every one nonzero modulo image ∂4. Proper pivot-descending reduction of all 273 cycles gives exactly three distinct nonzero quotient classes, exactly 91 supports each; every vertex belongs to exactly 105. Distinct lexicographic representatives 12357,12358,12378 satisfy alpha+beta=gamma. The finite enumeration is exhaustive and thus proves the exact labeled-object census, not a finite extrapolation.
